segments_b.text: Halo does not decide whether you belong. Halo reveals whether you are prepared to participate in peace.
Rise above the story in which you are always the center. From higher ground, every life has a path you cannot see.
Can you see beyond your own position?
Do not show me only your light.
Name what follows behind you.
What is acknowledged may walk beside you.
What is denied will walk ahead of you.
Can you carry your shadow without placing it upon another?
Tell me who walks beside you by choice.
Loyalty taken through fear is not loyalty, and no one enters the circle by standing
upon another.
Can you be long without requiring obedience?
Strength is not measured by what you can enter.
It is revealed by what you do when a boundary says no farther.
Can you meet a boundary without making it a battle?
You are not asked to prove that you are perfect.
You are invited to widen your view, enter through relationship, honor a boundary and
know what you carry.
Beyond this threshold is the living circle of the 13.
Nothing there exists for you to dominate.
If you can enter without surrendering yourself or taking freedom from another, the way is
open.
